name: 35205 · Birmingham, AL
findings: ZIP 35205 (Birmingham) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35205 (Birmingham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35205 (Birmingham) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
